name: AutoResponder
short: Server-wide automatic replies triggered by configured words or phrases.
description: Moderators configure triggers and replies; Fatboy automatically responds when someone says a matching word or phrase anywhere in the Discord server, including threads. Case-insensitive whole-word matching, only one reply per message, configurable cooldown, persistent per-server rules, and no-mention replies.
author: Will
end_user_data_statement: Stores server-specific trigger strings, moderator-provided response text, enabled status, and cooldown settings. No Discord user IDs or raw messages are saved. Temporary per-channel cooldowns are held in memory only.
install_msg: AutoResponder installed. Load with [p]load autoresponder and configure a response using [p]ar add hello | Hey there! Manage Server permission required. Enable Message Content Intent.
